Security team reopened questions around data residency and HSM/KMS integration — asking for air-gapped option even though Halcyon prefers a VPC deployment.

Signals: unresponsiveness from champion's replacement (Director level) — meetings cancelled, few replies. Procurement flagged a hiring freeze + 2026 budget hold for new platform commitments. Sales cycle slowed to a drip. Competitor outreach: Commercial discount from OpenAI + existing credit from Anthropic (via reseller) — used by infrastructure team for internal experiments.

- "We like the latency profile but we can't commit until org settles" — Platform Eng director (paraphrase).
- Security: "need KMS + audit logs + 3yr retention for logs, otherwise no go" (security review doc open).
- SE comment: "would accept a small scope POC limited to embeddings + rerank to prove unit economics."

Current posture: Stalled / closed-won unlikely in near term. AE to attempt re-engage once reorg completes. Keep trial credits active; offer technical office hours and a trimmed POC to keep momentum.
